fixed_scope.original_scope: Composition statements use the fixed Standard model and selected classical object family.
header_first_7_lines: Fix a model $D$ of the classical and synthetic Adams systems. All maps, quotient objects, filtrations and page labels in each statement are taken in this model. In the statements quoted from \cite{LWX126}, spectra are $2$-completed, connective and of finite type.
For the level-indexed rules, page-extension comparisons and the
composition theorem, $D$ is the fixed Standard model and the classical
objects belong to its selected family. Statements about general filtered
groups or convergent towers specify their own data explicitly.
